title: Graves, letters and a crown
changes: New quest The Empty Grave in Gravemoor Cemetery (level 15): listen to the mourners, then dig the right grave. A wrong guess wakes the dead.
New quest Two Letters from Old Garrick, after the Redfang Chief: give one letter to the law or the other to mercy. Your choice changes who trades with you and what folk say afterwards.
New quest The Crown in the Sand in Kharsun (levels 38 to 39): a crowned seal in the desert leads to Ostrevar's Envoy.
